name: Heroines' Chord
storyline:
In the wake of the Magical Girls' war with Evil Ark and the assault of Omnicide, the heroines who fight for this world had become known to nearly everyone in it. Most of the public praised them, but there were organizations that found them a nuisance.

It was then that the heroines' enemies pooled their money to found an anti-heroine mercenary unit: "Counter Force." Its backers included the secret evil organization Shalldark, and Glode, a corporation overrun by demons.

"Counter Force" tears through the city, destroying everything it can to lure the heroines into the open. Against an enemy of overwhelming power, the heroines join forces and fight back!
summary: A classic JRPG dungeon crawler. You play as the heroines who defend the city against an alliance of sinister organizations and corporations. Having pooled their resources, these shadowy forces have established a new mercenary unit with a single purpose — to destroy you. They call it 'Counter Force.'
